stage_info.name: reconstruction
stage_info.description: 3D reconstruction stage: Ab initio reconstruction and 3D refinement using RELION

steps.name: ab_initio_reconstruction
steps.description: Perform ab initio 3D reconstruction (de novo 3D refinement) from particles without a reference. This runs relion_refine with --denovo_3dref flag, then aligns symmetry using relion_align_symmetry to create an initial 3D model.

input_requirements.input_star: Path to particles STAR file from particle picking/selection stage (e.g., Select/jobXXX/particles.star)

steps.name: particle_reextraction
steps.description: Re-extract particles from micrographs with original pixel size without scaling. This is typically done after ab initio reconstruction to re-extract particles at full resolution for refinement. Uses relion_preprocess with --reextract_data_star to extract particles from original micrographs using coordinates and orientations from ab initio reconstruction.

input_requirements.reextract_data_star: Path to particles STAR file from ab initio reconstruction (e.g., InitialModel/jobXXX/run_it200_data.star). Contains coordinates and orientations. Auto-detected if available from ab initio step.
input_requirements.micrographs_star: Path to original micrographs STAR file from preprocessing (e.g., Select/jobXXX/micrographs.star). This ensures particles are extracted with original pixel size.

steps.name: refinement_3d
steps.description: Perform 3D refinement (auto-refinement) of particles using a reference map. This runs relion_refine_mpi (or relion_refine) with --auto_refine flag to refine the 3D structure with split random halves validation.

input_requirements.input_star: Path to particles STAR file. Should use re-extracted particles from particle_reextraction step (e.g., ReExtract/jobXXX/particles.star) for best results. Auto-detected if available from re-extraction step.
input_requirements.ref_mrc: Path to reference 3D map (MRC file) from ab initio reconstruction (e.g., InitialModel/jobXXX/initial_model.mrc) or previous refinement. Auto-detected if available from ab initio step.
